summary: SBA Communications Corp filed an 8-K to disclose entry into an underwriting agreement for a registered public offering of $3.5 billion aggregate principal amount of senior notes across three tranches: $1.35B of 4.875% Senior Notes due 2030, $1.35B of 5.150% Senior Notes due 2031, and $800M of 5.450% Senior Notes due 2033. Proceeds will repay its senior secured term loan (due 2031) and outstanding revolving credit facility borrowings. Underwriters include Morgan Stanley, Barclays, Wells Fargo, and Goldman Sachs. This is a routine debt refinancing, not a special situation.
